No one really talks about this part of divorce.

The part where you are the one who has to leave everything behind.  
The home you just built.  
The financial stability you worked so hard for.  
Becoming a single mom again when you never planned to be.

The long, quiet goodbyes.  
The heartbreak of leaving your dog, their little family, and the life you thought was yours forever.  
The grief of walking away from a dream.

But what people don’t see…  
is what you walk *toward*.

I walked away from abuse in every form.  
From a situation that was slowly breaking me… mentally, emotionally, and physically.  
A situation I truly believe I may not have survived.

And on the other side of that?  
God met me there.

A new home.  
A safe, peaceful environment for me and my son to truly thrive.  
A business that is growing into something bigger than I ever imagined.  
And the unexpected gift of reconnecting with a dear friend… and finding a deeper love for life again.

I didn’t just leave something behind.  
I found myself again.

And while the grief is real…  
the peace is louder.

If you’re in a season of leaving, rebuilding, or choosing yourself…  
just know this:

There is so much beauty waiting on the other side of what feels unbearable. 🤍
:::
